svg.title: Figure 5. Which sectors carry the fingerprints of designed amendments
svg.text: Figure 5. Which sectors carry the fingerprints of designed amendments
Each cell: deviation from a pure-chance world matched to the same amendment-count distribution (z-score). Top block: simulated theory worlds. Bottom block: sectors, ranked by lock-in index.
B Design: scope gaps, no lock-in
SECTORS (Chicago, Oregon, Cook County; vendor share adds Washington)
Vendor share separates design from chance and renewals; escalation separates lock-in. Tier 1 (bold) = both plus acceleration. "thin" = fewer than 30 eligible contracts.
